@roles_required(Role.Code.ADMIN, Role.Code.WAREHOUSE)
@never_cache
@require_GET
def stock_overview(request):
    """Vista consolidada del inventario actual con alertas integradas (HUECO-01 + HUECO-02)."""
    from catalog.models import Product
    from datetime import timedelta

    today = timezone.localdate()
    soon = today + timedelta(days=30)

    products = (
        Product.objects
        .select_related("category", "initial_load")
        .prefetch_related("lots")
        .order_by("name")
    )

    # Productos activos con stock vendible igual o inferior al umbral mínimo, o sin unidades vigentes
    low_stock = [
        p for p in products
        if p.is_active and (p.sellable_stock <= p.minimum_stock or p.sellable_stock == 0)
    ]

    # Lotes próximos a vencer (en los próximos 30 días, sin incluir ya vencidos) con unidades disponibles
    from .models import Lot as LotModel
    expiring_lots = (
        LotModel.objects
        .filter(expiration_date__gt=today, expiration_date__lte=soon, available_quantity__gt=0)
        .select_related("product")
        .order_by("expiration_date")
    )
    expired_lots = (
        LotModel.objects
        .filter(expiration_date__lte=today, available_quantity__gt=0)
        .select_related("product")
        .order_by("expiration_date")
    )

    return render(request, "inventory/stock_overview.html", {
        "products": products,
        "today": today,
        "low_stock": low_stock,
        "expiring_lots": expiring_lots,
        "expired_lots": expired_lots,
    })

def _admin_summary() -> dict:
    """HUECO-08 / HU-REP-01: resumen del negocio para el administrador."""
    from datetime import timedelta

    from django.db.models import Sum
    from django.utils import timezone

    from cash.models import CashShift
    from catalog.models import Product
    from inventory.models import Lot
    from sales.models import Sale

    today = timezone.localdate()
    sales_today = Sale.objects.filter(confirmed_at__date=today)
    agg = sales_today.aggregate(total=Sum("total_amount"), discount=Sum("discount_amount"))
    return {
        "sales_count": sales_today.count(),
        "sales_total": agg["total"] or 0,
        "discount_total": agg["discount"] or 0,
        "open_shifts": CashShift.objects.filter(status=CashShift.Status.OPEN).count(),
        "low_stock": sum(
            1
            for p in Product.objects.filter(is_active=True, category__is_active=True).prefetch_related("lots")
            if p.sellable_stock < p.minimum_stock or p.sellable_stock == 0
        ),
        "expiring": Lot.objects.filter(
            expiration_date__gt=today,
            expiration_date__lte=today + timedelta(days=30),
            available_quantity__gt=0,
        ).count(),
        "expired": Lot.objects.filter(
            expiration_date__lte=today,
            available_quantity__gt=0,
        ).count(),
    }
